plan.melodySummary: The theme migrates through the ensemble by phrase: Flute states it, Trumpet answers with terraced force, Alto Sax takes the flowing eighth-note descent, and Flute returns for the cadential close, with imitative echoes trailing each entry a bar later. The dynamic arc rises from a gentle !p! opening through a brilliant !f! Trumpet peak in mm.5-8, sustains full eighth-note momentum through mm.9-15, then resolves to a warm !mp! cadence.

sections.label: Phrase A
sections.notes: State the theme at !p! with clean Baroque articulation; Alto Sax enters one bar later imitating your opening two notes.

sections.label: Phrase A'
sections.notes: Restate the theme at terraced !f!, bright and detached; Flute weaves a running eighth-note countermelody above.

sections.label: Phrase B
sections.notes: Carry the continuous eighth-note sequences at !f!, shaping each step of the descending figure evenly; Flute echoes fragments a bar behind.

sections.label: Phrase B' (Cadence)
sections.notes: Take back the melody at !mp!, add a trill on the final cadence in m.16; Alto Sax provides a quieter inner descant beneath you.

Flute.instruction: Lead the opening statement at !p! and the cadential close at !mp!; between those, spin light eighth-note countermelodies and imitative echoes, always yielding volume to the current melody carrier. Trill at the final cadence.

Trumpet.instruction: Tacet in the soft outer phrases. Enter for the bright !f! restatement in mm.5-8, then drop to sustained !mp! harmonic support in mm.9-12 well below the Alto Sax melody.

Alto Sax.instruction: Provide imitative inner-voice entries and harmony in mm.1-8 at a level under the carrier, carry the driving eighth-note sequences at !f! in mm.9-12, then a soft descant under the Flute in mm.13-16.

Bassoon.instruction: Play a steady walking bass in quarters throughout, following the functional harmony; terrace your dynamics with each phrase (!p!, !f!, !f!, !mp!) to match the melody carrier, never overpowering it.
